caseNameFull: Butler v. Thompson, Central Registrar for the County of Arlington
attorneys: John Locke Creen for appellant. J. Lindsay Almond, Jr., Attorney General of Virginia, Walter E. Rogers and John W. Jackson for appellees.

opinions.text:
Appeal from the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia. Per Curiam: The motion to affirm is granted and the judgment is affirmed.

Mr. Justice Douglas dissents.
